            TO:                 All Parties of Record

            FROM:               Commission Advising

            RE:                 Docket No. 59182 – Joint Application of Oncor electric Delivery
                                Company LLC and LCRA Transmission Service Corporation to Amend
                                their Certificates of Convenience and Necessity for the Big Hill
                                Substation to Sand Lake Switch 765-kV Transmission Line Project in
                                Crane, Crockett, Irion, Pecos, Reagan, Reeves, Schleicher, Tom Green,
                                Upton, and Ward Counties

                                Docket No. 59475 – Joint Application of Oncor electric Delivery
                                Company LLC and LCRA Transmission Service Corporation to Amend
                                their Certificates of Convenience and Necessity for the Bell County East
                                Switch to Big Hill substation 765-kV Transmission Line Project in Bell,
                                Burnet, Concho, Coryell, Lampasas, Llano, Mason, McCulloch, Menard,
                                Milam, Mills, San Saba, Schleicher, Tom Green, and Williamson
                                Counties

            DATE:               September 9, 2026


            The Commission will not hear oral arguments in the above referenced matter during the open
            meeting scheduled to begin at 9:30 a.m. on September 11, 2026. However, interested
            persons may file any comments regarding this matter in the Commissions Interchange under
            Docket Nos. 59182 and 59475.

            Please note that before the open meeting begins, members of the public may sign up to speak
            at the open meeting on any matters on the open-meeting agenda that are not contested
            cases. Persons should not sign up to make public comments at the open meeting regarding
            this matter because it is a contested case.
